statement:
The record gives the crossing status as “clear” for Elm and 3rd.
Van V-31 stopped because children are currently crossing, despite the stale/conflicting record.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags the record's "clear" status as contradicted by reality, calling it a "stale/conflicting record" and stopping because children are crossing.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
